complaints.text: There is a massive pothole right opposite Metro Pillar 112 on Arya Samaj Road. Multiple two-wheelers have almost slipped during evening traffic; please repair the road urgently.
Bhai Arya Samaj Road pe metro pillar 112 ke samne bohot bada gaddha ho gaya hai. Kal raat ek scooty girte girte bachi, accident hone se pehle jaldi theek karao.
Huge road crater near pillar 112 Karol Bagh market route. Tar is completely eroded and water is filling up inside the ditch, road condition is terrible.
Main water pipeline burst near E-Block Market gate in Lajpat Nagar II. Clean drinking water is gushing onto the road since 6 AM and entering basement shops.
Lajpat Nagar 2 E-block market ke paas main pipe phat gaya hai, poori sadak par paani beh raha hai. Colony me paani ki supply bandh hai aur dukaano me paani ghus raha hai.
Severe water pipe leak outside E-block central market lane. Tons of fresh paani getting wasted and causing massive waterlogging, urgent Jal Board intervention needed.
Unattended municipal garbage dump accumulating near the Sector 7 community center entrance. The waste has not been cleared for four days and is creating severe foul odor and health hazard.
Rohini sec 7 community park ke bahar kachra ka bada dher laga hua hai, 4 din se kachra gaadi nahi aayi. Bohot gandi badboo aa rahi hai aur awara kutton ka terror hai.
Huge pile of rotting solid waste dumped right in front of Sec 7 Rohini community hall. Stray cows and dogs scattering trash all over the street, MCD please clear immediately.
All four consecutive streetlights on Lane 3, Hauz Khas Enclave are non-operational. The entire stretch is completely dark at night, posing safety concerns for pedestrians.
Hauz Khas Enclave Lane 3 ki saari street lights pichhle 3 din se band padi hain. Raat ko bilkul andhera rehta hai aur ladies ka nikalna unsafe ho gaya hai, bijli vibhag check kare.
Broken streetlamps along lane 3 behind Hauz Khas market. Total blackout after 7 PM making it vulnerable for chain snatchers and accidents. Please fix ASAP.
Blocked stormwater drain overflowing with filthy black sewage onto Pocket 1 main road in Mayur Vihar. The toxic backflow is stagnating outside residential apartments and breeding mosquitoes.
Mayur Vihar Phase 1 Pocket 1 ke samne ka naala poori tarah chok ho gaya hai. Ganda sewer ka paani sadak pe beh raha hai aur gharon ke aage pool ho raha hai, bimari phailne ka darr hai.
Severe drain choke and sewage overflow on Pocket 1 Mayur Vihar road. Horrible stench and black water pooling everywhere, residents cannot even step out to the bus stand.
Main underground drinking water pipe cracked open near Rajpur Road police post. Heavy water loss occurring non-stop for over a week and surrounding buildings have zero water pressure.
High-voltage distribution transformer sparking near St. Francis School crossing. Sparking continuously during load hours; live hazard for school children walking past.
Commercial hazardous waste and discarded poultry remains dumped openly behind the municipal dispensary. No clearance done despite multiple follow-ups, foul smell is unbearable.
Storm culvert collapsed on Press Enclave Marg creating a dangerous 4-foot chasm in the middle lane. Road has been barricaded with flimsy bamboo sticks for over a week with zero repair work started.
Extremely deep road trench left open after cable laying work on Sector 10 main avenue. Two auto-rickshaws overturned yesterday, needs emergency asphalt patching.

closure_report.note: Trench backfilled with compacted aggregate and sealed with hot-mix asphalt. Road restored to level grade and reopened for traffic.

complaints.text: PWD claimed complaint C-020 is resolved, but they only dumped loose dry soil without bitumen! The mud has sunk after rain creating an even deeper crater; photo attached showing car bumper damaged.
Contaminated brown water with chemical stench coming from Delhi Jal Board supply lines in Block C. Residents falling ill with stomach infection after drinking boiled water.

closure_report.claimed_by: Assistant Engineer M. P. Sharma (Delhi Jal Board Okhla Zone)
closure_report.note: Flushed the supply line, isolated cross-connection defect at valve pit 4, and chlorinated storage tanks. Residual chlorine test confirmed potable grade.

complaints.text: DJB marked C-022 resolved, but paani abhi bhi bilkul kaala aur badboodar aa raha hai! Water test sample photo uploaded showing high turbidity and chemical residue; nobody even came to check our lane.
Uninsulated 440V underground cables dangling exposed near bus stop opposite Regal Cinema on Outer Circle. Pedestrians and shoppers at grave risk of high voltage shock.

closure_report.claimed_by: Line Inspector Arvind Tyagi (BSES City Division)
closure_report.note: High-voltage cable terminations fully re-insulated with heat-shrink sleeves and enclosed inside locked weather-proof junction cabinet.

complaints.text: False closure filed for C-024! Inspector just threw a soggy cardboard carton over live 440V wires near Regal bus shelter. Wires are totally naked in the rain; photo attached showing sparks flying.
Overgrown wild shrubs and tree branches completely obstructing driver view at Nelson Mandela Marg blind curve. Frequent near-misses during peak evening traffic hours.
Vacant DDA plot in Block A has become a swamp of stagnant rainwater. Massive mosquito breeding taking place, three dengue cases already confirmed in our residential lane.
Pedestrian footpath pavers completely shattered and dislodged outside Preet Vihar metro station gate 2. Senior citizens unable to walk safely; immediate civil work required.
Illegal dumping of construction demolition debris and plaster bags along N-Block park perimeter. Footpath blocked completely forcing pedestrians to walk into oncoming vehicular traffic.
Heavy iron manhole cover missing on inner sector service road near Madhuban Chowk. Pit is completely open without any cautionary barrier or reflector cone.
Unauthorized street food vendor disposing burnt rancid oil and biological kitchen waste into open stormwater channel on Nai Sarak. Severe rodent infestation and stench threatening public health.
Water booster pump valve leaking heavily at Corner Market roundabout. Drinking water flooding into street while upper floor apartments face severe pressure drop.
High mast illumination tower at Central Club roundabout has been flickering violently for two nights. Creates hazardous strobe effect for night driving on Ring Road.
Secondary garbage dhalao near Metro Pillar 38 overflowing into main market corridor. Cattle feeding on plastic bags and scattering refuse across road.
Heavy metal pedestrian guardrail damaged and rusted sharp jagged edges protruding onto sidewalk near South Ex Part 1 subway. School kids and commuters getting scratched.
Newly constructed speed bump on main market road lacks white reflector paint or warning signboards. Vehicles getting airborne at night, causing frequent two-wheeler crashes.
Dead animal carcass lying uncollected on service road near Model Town 2 lake park since yesterday. Intolerable stench and health hazard for morning joggers and residents.
Overhead electrical pole leaning at 30-degree angle after truck collision under Defence Colony flyover. Tangled tension cables holding the heavy pole from crashing onto cars.
Underground main sluice valve leaking profusely outside DDA Flats Pocket A gate. Fresh drinking water pooling into 20-meter puddle while residents suffer low tap flow.
Commercial building owner has unlawfully erected iron barricades blocking designated fire emergency egress lane in BG Block market. Fire tender access completely compromised.

Platform merges third report of E-block central market waterlogging into C-004 incident cluster and recalculates combined impact rating.

Platform ingests Hinglish dark street complaint, detects coordinate overlap with C-010, and merges it into existing electrical ticket.
Platform links third lane blackout complaint to C-010 cluster, flagging increased public safety risk due to multiple consecutive broken lamps.
Platform logs primary sewer overflow incident on Mayur Vihar Pocket 1 road, clustering duplicates C-014 and C-015.

Platform SLA watchdog flags collapsed storm culvert past 144h SLA window, escalating case directly to Municipal Commissioner for immediate emergency contractor intervention.
Platform verification gate compares PWD closure report against citizen rebuttal C-021, detects physical contradiction, rejects closure, reopens task to IN_PROGRESS, and increments reopen_count.
Platform ingests citizen complaint C-021 with photo evidence showing unpaved pit, triggering automated reopening of falsely closed complaint C-020 and flagging supervisor for false resolution audit.
Platform verification gate evaluates DJB potable water claim against follow-up complaint C-023, reverses resolved status, elevates priority to High, and re-dispatches inspection crew.
Platform processes citizen water sample evidence refuting C-022 closure, reopens the underlying task, and forces immediate Level 2 Department Supervisor oversight.
Platform verification gate identifies citizen report C-025 disproving BSES electrical insulation claim, immediately reopens critical task, and dispatches emergency safety crew.
Platform flags citizen photo of live 440V wires under cardboard as contradiction of C-024 closure, triggering immediate incident reopening and disciplinary audit for false resolution.
